section.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Starting Your Project
section.description: We've answered the most common questions about pricing, timelines, development, support, and our workflow. If you still have questions, our team is always happy to help.

general-why-novyra.question: Why should I choose Novyra Technologies?
general-why-novyra.answer: Most agencies quote a price and go quiet until delivery. We run weekly demo calls on working software, give you a shared repository with every commit visible from day one, and hand over full source code ownership at the end — no vendor lock-in, no black box.

general-industries.question: Which industries do you work with?
general-industries.answer: We work with healthcare, education, SaaS, eCommerce, startups, finance, logistics, and many other industries. Every solution is customized to match your business goals instead of using one-size-fits-all templates.

general-process.question: How does the project process work?
general-process.answer: Every project follows the same six steps: Discovery → Strategy → UI/UX Design → Development → QA → Launch & Support. You'll receive regular updates throughout, so you always know what's happening.

general-international.question: Can you work with international clients?
general-international.answer: We work with clients remotely from anywhere in the world — meetings, project tracking, and communication are all handled online for a smooth collaboration experience.

general-nda.question: Do you sign NDAs?
general-nda.answer: We can sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement before starting your project, so your business ideas, documents, and sensitive information stay private and secure.

pricing-cost.question: How much does a project cost?
pricing-cost.answer: The price depends on your project's size, features, and overall complexity. After understanding your requirements, we'll provide a detailed and transparent quotation.

pricing-custom.question: Why is pricing custom?
pricing-custom.answer: Every project differs in scope, integrations, and features, so the final quote depends on your specific requirements. The figures above are accurate starting points for each tier, refined into a fixed quote after a free consultation.

pricing-consultation-free.question: Is the consultation free?
pricing-consultation-free.answer: Your first consultation is completely free — we'll discuss your goals, recommend the right solution, and answer your questions without any obligation.

pricing-hidden-charges.question: Are there any hidden charges?
pricing-hidden-charges.answer: We believe in complete pricing transparency — everything included in your project is clearly listed before development begins, with nothing added later.

pricing-milestones.question: Can I pay in milestones?
pricing-milestones.answer: Most projects follow milestone-based payments, which keeps the process transparent and means you only pay as work actually progresses.

pricing-upgrade.question: Can I upgrade my package later?
pricing-upgrade.answer: Additional features can be added anytime — your website or application is built to grow as your business does.

dev-tech-stack.question: Which technologies do you use?
dev-tech-stack.answer: We use React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, GraphQL, AWS, Docker, and more. We always choose modern, reliable technologies that are suitable for your project.

dev-responsive.question: Will my website be mobile responsive?
dev-responsive.answer: Every website we build is optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop, so visitors get a smooth experience on any screen size.

dev-custom-software.question: Do you build custom software?
dev-custom-software.answer: Every project is built specifically for your business — we don't rely on generic templates for custom solutions.

dev-admin-dashboards.question: Do you provide admin dashboards?
dev-admin-dashboards.answer: We develop secure, easy-to-use admin panels so you can manage content, users, and business data without needing technical knowledge.

dev-api-integrations.question: Can you integrate third-party APIs?
dev-api-integrations.answer: We integrate payment gateways, CRMs, AI services, analytics, and many other APIs, so your software connects easily with the tools you already use.

support-post-launch.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
support-post-launch.answer: Every project includes a post-launch support window — we handle bug fixes, updates, and technical assistance after launch.

support-response-time.question: How quickly do you respond?
support-response-time.answer: Our internal target is to respond to support requests within 24 hours, with critical issues prioritized first.

support-maintain-existing.question: Can you maintain my existing website?
support-maintain-existing.answer: We provide maintenance for websites we built and for ones built by other developers, improving performance or security and adding new features whenever needed.

support-monitoring.question: Do you offer website monitoring?
support-monitoring.answer: Monitoring is available as part of our maintenance plans, covering uptime, performance, and security so your website keeps running smoothly.

support-new-features.question: Can I request new features later?
support-new-features.answer: Your project is designed to be scalable from the start, so future improvements stay simple and efficient to add.

seo-included.question: Is SEO included?
seo-included.answer: Every website is built following technical SEO best practices, so search engines can understand and index it more effectively.

seo-google.question: Will my website be optimized for Google?
seo-google.answer: We optimize performance, metadata, structured data, and Core Web Vitals — the factors that give a website a real chance at ranking higher.

seo-speed.question: Do you improve website speed?
seo-speed.answer: Performance optimization is included in every project, since fast-loading pages improve both user experience and search rankings.

seo-ongoing.question: Do you provide ongoing SEO services?
seo-ongoing.answer: Monthly SEO plans are available if you want ongoing work on rankings, traffic, and visibility rather than a one-time setup.

seo-migration.question: Can you migrate my website without losing SEO?
seo-migration.answer: We follow safe migration practices — proper redirects and SEO planning protect your existing search rankings during the move.

ai-integrate.question: Can you integrate AI into my website?
ai-integrate.answer: We build AI-powered features and automation that can improve customer support, productivity, and overall business efficiency.

ai-models.question: Which AI models do you support?
ai-models.answer: We work with OpenAI, Claude, Google Gemini, and other modern AI platforms. We select the model that fits your use case.

ai-automate.question: Can AI automate business tasks?
ai-automate.answer: AI can take over repetitive work like customer support replies, lead qualification, reporting, and content generation.

ai-saas.question: Do you build AI SaaS products?
ai-saas.answer: We develop complete AI-powered SaaS platforms from idea to deployment, built to scale and tailored to your business.

ai-secure.question: Is AI secure?
ai-secure.answer: We follow industry best practices for security and privacy — sensitive data is protected with secure authentication and encrypted communication.

integrations-payment.question: Which payment gateways do you support?
integrations-payment.answer: We integrate Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal, Cashfree, and other providers. The payment gateway is selected based on your target market and business requirements.

integrations-crm-erp.question: Can you connect my CRM or ERP?
integrations-crm-erp.answer: We integrate popular CRM and ERP platforms to help centralize customer information and automate business processes.

integrations-analytics.question: Do you integrate analytics tools?
integrations-analytics.answer: We support Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity, Mixpanel, and more, so you can understand visitor behavior and measure growth.

integrations-notifications.question: Can you integrate email and notification services?
integrations-notifications.answer: We integrate email, SMS, WhatsApp, and push notification services to automate and improve customer communication.

integrations-apis.question: Can you connect my software with third-party APIs?
integrations-apis.answer: We build secure REST API, GraphQL, and webhook integrations so your application can communicate seamlessly with external services and business tools.

infoPanel.description: Our team is available to discuss your project requirements, recommend the right solution, and answer any technical or business questions.
